stateDir.label: State directory
stateDir.help: Where consent and the delivery ledger are kept. Must be private to the Gateway.

owner.profileId.label: Device owner profile
owner.profileId.help: The one person who owns every paired iPhone and iPad on this Gateway (see `openclaw users list`). Do not use on a Gateway where other people pair devices.

gateway.cliPath.label: OpenClaw CLI path
gateway.cliPath.help: Path to the OpenClaw CLI entry script used for push.test and node.list.

gateway.url.label: Gateway URL
gateway.url.help: The local Gateway, loopback ws:// without credentials.

gateway.identityDir.label: Plugin CLI identity
gateway.identityDir.help: State directory of the plugin's own CLI identity, made with scripts/pair-cli-identity.mjs. It can only read and write, and must be separate from the Gateway's own state directory.

logEvidenceShape.label: Log evidence field names
logEvidenceShape.help: Troubleshooting: log which run origin, status values and field names the Gateway provided for each finished run. Never message text or ids.

alert.content.label: Alert content
alert.content.help: generic: "Your reply is ready." preview: the conversation's name and the start of the reply. Previews appear on the lock screen and pass through Apple's push service.
